events.text: The bug is in `src/invoice.py`: `math.floor` truncates instead of rounding half up as finance policy FIN-12 requires. Floating-point error can also flip exact halves like 10.125, so I'll use `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

I changed `tax()` in `src/invoice.py` to round half up to the cent, as FIN-12 specifies, instead of flooring.

For `tax(112.50, 0.09)`, the exact product is 10.125, which now rounds to 10.13 and matches `test_invoice_tax`. I used `Decimal` built from `str()` so binary floating-point error can't push an exact half to the wrong side. I haven't run the suite, since I can't; CI will confirm.

The function now returns a `float`, so existing callers see the same type as before.
